name: Public Facilities Financing Authority Adjournment Memo
agenda_text:
Office of Chair Joe LaCava
The Public Facilities Financing Authority
of the City of San Diego
M e m o r a N d u m
date: March 12, 2026
to: Honorable City Councilmembers
from: Chair Joe LaCava
subject: Public Facilities Financing Authority Meeting Adjourned
__________________________________________________________
There are no items of business for the regularly scheduled meeting of the Public Facilities Financing Authority on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 2:00 pm. Therefore, such meeting of the Public Facilities Financing Authority is adjourned.
The next regularly scheduled Public Facilities Financing Authority meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, at 2:00 pm.
If you have questions, please contact Luz Anaya Luna, Director of Legislative Affairs, at 619-235-5880 or lanayaluna@sandiego.gov and Heidi Palmer, Legislative Analyst, at 619-533-3920 or palmerh@sandiego.gov
cc: Honorable Mayor Todd Gloria
Honorable City Attorney Heather Ferbert
Diana Fuentes, City Clerk
Charles Modica, Independent Budget Analyst
